reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported database: a Go SQLite driver is declared in go.mod. Deployz hosts PostgreSQL and MySQL only.
reviews.reason: Navidrome uses SQLite as its only database engine and the shown files show no setting that selects PostgreSQL or MySQL instead.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /data (Dockerfile), VOLUME /music (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: Navidrome keeps its database and music library on local disk, and nothing shown moves that data to S3 or a managed service.
